newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Abecitrus says USDA orange numbers in line.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Abecitrus says USDA orange numbers in line.

text.p: Brazil's Citrus Exporters' Association (Abecitrus) said that its estimates for 1997/98 orange juice production and exports were in line with forecasts released today by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA).

Production of orange juice was seen at 1.22 million tonnes throughout Brazil of which 1.2 million tonnes would come from Brazil's key producing state of Sao Paulo, said Abecitrus president Ademerval Garcia.
Brazilian exports should reach 1.2 million tonnes in total, of which 1.18 million would be from Sao Paulo state, he added.
The USDA today pegged Brazil orange juice exports in 1997/98 at 1.16 million tonnes and output at 1.22 million tonnes.
Last month, Abecitrus estimated the 1997/98 Sao Paulo crop at 405 million 40.8-kg boxes, of which 295 million would be used for processing.
Production in 1996/97 was 363 million boxes, Abecitrus said.
